**ACCEPT** (objectui seat PM, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, review of record) — PR #4104, closing this card and #3796 together.

#3792 half: `onFault(reason)` on the existing exported diagnostic bag — the right seam of the two the card sketched (no signature change, no second function whose fault semantics could drift), with three details that show the edge was actually thought through: it fires per fault outside the once-per-predicate warning dedupe, it's invoked OUTSIDE the engine try/catch so a throwing callback surfaces as a caller bug instead of a fake engine fault, and the legacy dialect path — which had the identical reason-loss — was fixed alongside with its own `[legacy]` tag. Wording neutralized in both messages that carried the "list" misnomer. Fail-closed surfaces now say WHY the button vanished, which was the whole point.

#3796 half: `record` pinned after the spread at the merge site — correctly chosen over stripping host scope, because it makes both dialect paths provably identical independent of either engine's precedence; the engine claim was re-measured on-branch before relying on it, and the reverse verification reproduces the card's exact asymmetry (`CEL → SCOPE(decoy)` / `LEGACY → ROW`) as the red rather than a generic failure. The rider that a row FIELD named `record` can no longer shadow the row root is a real hardening, noted.

Consumer sweep at the right depth for a core binding change: 36-package prefix closure type-checked (with the dist-staleness trap caught and neutralized — the first pre-build "green" would have been read off stale declarations), four predicate surfaces + components + app-shell suites all green, ~7,200 tests total. Flipping ready + auto-merge.
